name: B10-0190/2025 (ECR) – Severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the widespread rape of civilians, especially children, in Sudan's war. It asks for international teams to investigate and record sexual violence so the perpetrators can be held to account, including soldiers from both sides. It calls for all fighting to stop and for safe zones where refugees and survivors can get medical care and legal help. It also urges the world to act quickly and bring those responsible to justice. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands investigations into wartime sexual violence and justice for victims.
- It affects people in Sudan, especially women, girls and children.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and other bodies.
